Subject: Draft MAP updates + overdue items — Syntra Health Q3 pilot

Hi Alyssa / Jason —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Attached is the MAP draft (v1.2) that captures the milestones we discussed and the owners we aligned on. Key points below: 

Summary of decisions from today’s call:
- Pilot scope: 25 internal users, inference for triage assistance (text gen) + embeddings for search.
- Target pilot start: internal testing week of 2027-07-18 (customer-facing pilot in early Aug).
- Target contract close date: 2027-06-30 (we flagged a possible shift if procurement needs more time).

MAP highlights (see attached Syntra_MAP_v1.2.xlsx):
- Milestone 1 — Security review intake: owner = Syntra SecOps (Alyssa) — due 2027-05-20
- Milestone 2 — Provisioning & IAM config: owner = Redwood (Ben) — due 2027-05-27
- Milestone 3 — SRE kickoff & perf criteria: owner = Syntra Eng (Jason) + Redwood (Neha) — due 2027-06-10
- Milestone 4 — Contract & SOW sign: owner = Syntra Procurement (Jason) — target 2027-06-30

Open dependencies / blockers:
- SOC2 evidence: we can share our SOC2 folder but need confirmation on which artifacts Syntra requires.
- Network connectivity: Syntra firewall rules for outbound to Redwood endpoints (Jason to provide egress list).
- Procurement lead time: if procurement needs >2 weeks for redlines, the close moves to mid-July.

Action items / asks for this week:
1) Alyssa: confirm point of contact for security intake and whether we should submit evidence to a secure link or via email.
2) Jason: share the procurement timeline PDF and any required legal templates (if you prefer, flag via procurement@syntrahealth.com).
3) Redwood (Ben/Neha): will update the MAP based on your responses and produce v1.3 next week.

Attachment: [Attachment: Syntra_MAP_v1.2.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

Thanks — looking forward to your quick confirms so we can lock milestones.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0112

Ben —

Thanks for the tidy recap and the MAP. A couple quick notes from procurement/security: 

- Security intake: please route SOC2 artifacts through our secure intake form (I attached a short procurement-facing timeline that shows internal review windows).
- Timing: procurement is likely to take at least 3 weeks once we get an initial SOW; can you hold the close window open until 2027-07-14 rather than 06-30? That gives our legal & privacy teams time to review.
- SLA ask: our legal has a standard question on data residency (we're US-only) and they'd like to confirm you support KMS-based keying for the dedicated pilot.

Quoting your milestone list for clarity:
> - Milestone 1 — Security review intake: owner = Syntra SecOps (Alyssa) — due 2027-05-20
> - Milestone 2 — Provisioning & IAM config: owner = Redwood (Ben) — due 2027-05-27

- Provisioning: Redwood devops (Neha) will send IAM onboarding playbook by 2027-05-18.

- Procurement redlines / legal template (Jason) — needed to start SOW drafting.
